classification: test-gate extension; product full-copy class and CSI provisioning unchanged
owning_scenario: Full-copy clone remains independent after source native volume and replicas are retired
conclusions: Official full-copy creates an independent copy. Pinned admission protects linked-clone parents from deletion, while completed full-copy has no such storage dependency.
Require completed full-copy and healthy three-node source/clone replicas before retiring any source object. Verify both application write directions first.

Only retire source Pod/PVC/Retain PV/Volume by recorded UIDs, with UID/resourceVersion API DELETE preconditions. Reject replacements across the entire source graph before first deletion. Refuse any remaining referring PV; wait for detached volume and native source replicas to disappear.
Keep the clone mounted through source deletion, confirm bytes, remount on another node and confirm new fsynced writes with original clone PVC/PV/Volume and replica identities.
Reuse the private general business journal for interruption recovery and scoped cleanup; no snapshot-finalizer manipulation or installation teardown.
coverage_boundary: Local source and deterministic contracts only until live qualification; no linked/nested dependency migration, expansion, backups, complete LONGHORN-49 or final delivery PASS.
